This is Roshni. Today, she is flying to a new city.
The airport is busy. Everyone is rushing. But Roshni is calm.
Then... her plane leaves without her! Does she cry? No. She smiles. There is always another flight.
Others drag heavy bags. Roshni carries just one small bag. A light bag. A light heart.
She buys a coffee and laughs. Small joys make big days.
An old uncle drops his ticket. Roshni gives it back. Now two people are smiling.
Soon, a new gate opens. Her gate. And Roshni is ready.
Because when life changes your flight... just walk like the runway is yours.
